blurb: Alaska Travel Adventures specializes in day tours and excursions in Southeast Alaska, providing experiences such as whale watching, canoeing, gold panning, and salmon bakes. They operate from multiple ports and focus on small group experiences with expert guides. Their tours include cultural, wildlife, and wilderness exploration with guaranteed ship return.
extraNote: Ship-guaranteed return on all tours · Tours operate in most weather conditions; dress in warm layers and bring gloves and extra socks for kayaking
